    Medium
    Spray paint on reclaimed plywood
    Materials
    105 x 60cm
    Size
    105 × 60 × 2 cm (41.3 × 23.6 × 0.8 in)
    Year
    2026

    I love giving old materials new life, especially wood. I grew up helping out in my dad's workshop and studied furniture design, so to be able to use my skills to breathe life into something that may have gone to landfill is really satisfying. The plywood from this piece was salvaged 7 years ago from the wardrobes in our house, whilst renovating. The wood has lots of character from its time as a storage space, hence the name, Narnia.
